subject: Geopolitics
title: The Arms Race
description: A fast breakdown of The Arms Race for builders.

hook.text: By 1986 the world had 70,000 nuclear warheads. Enough to destroy civilization many times over.

buildup.text: Each side built more weapons to match the other. Security through strength became security through excess.

discovery.text: The arms race drained both budgets. The USSR spent 25% of GDP on military while consumers went without.

twist.text: Reagan's Star Wars bluff forced the USSR to spend on tech it couldn't afford. The race broke the weaker side.

climax.text: Arms races still happen. Today it's hypersonic missiles, cyber weapons, and AI-guided drones.

punchline.text: The race never ends. The finish line just moves.

quiz.question: What effect did the arms race have on the Soviet economy?
options: It boosted technological innovation across all sectors
It drained 25% of GDP while consumers went without
It had minimal impact on civilian spending
